hardware.subtitle: CPU / GPU / RAM / Disk / Mainboard / Display / Network - read-only, nothing is modified

speedTest.title: Speed Test
speedTest.subtitle: Latency / download / upload via public endpoints (Cloudflare); results are affected by proxies and firewalls. Read-only, no system settings are changed.

log.downloadNoData: Download failed: no data (endpoint unreachable or blocked by proxy/firewall)

agentMonitor.title: Agent Monitor
agentMonitor.subtitle: Live sensors and recorder status from the agent's RPC control plane (connects to CrashScope.Agent, not the in-process recorder)
agentMonitor.confirmStop: Stop the agent's recording session? It is marked clean only after successful shutdown; faults remain recorded.

agentIncidents.title: Agent Incidents
agentIncidents.subtitle: Incident bundles collected by the connected agent - the viewer for headless (scheduled task) deployments

agentActions.title: Agent Actions
agentActions.subtitle: Reversible system actions on the connected agent - every change is recorded with its reason and can be rolled back
agentActions.reasonRequired: A reason is required - that is the forensic contract.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: Past crash incidents detected by the flight recorder

comparison.title: Incident Comparison
comparison.subtitle: Select exactly 2 incidents and click Compare
comparison.supportTip: Heuristic evidence support, not a calibrated probability

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Crash reconstruction timeline: telemetry, processes, GPU transitions, Windows events

settings.title: Settings
